title: heartbeats-touch repeatable is a silent no-op in bullmq; working-agent heartbeat never refreshed
evidence: maintenance-worker.ts:26-38 (touchWorkingAgents typeof check; module-private export agent-heartbeat.ts:31); register-socket-server.ts:505-507 (toucher only when !bullmq); agent-service.ts:650-666 (sweep reads lastHeartbeat)
impact: Orphan-sweep can pause actively-working agents once last_heartbeat goes stale (crash-recovery contract inverted: live agents look dead)
fix_sketch: Export touchWorkingAgents from agent-heartbeat.ts and call directly; add worker-side lease (agentGate.touchHeartbeat) or run toucher in worker process [recon 2026-10-07: code-fix verified; ledger has no Status column]

title: Resume enqueue failure is log-only; API returns 200 resume success
evidence: routes/runs.ts:16-33 (catch logs; :69 returns 200); same in register-socket-server.ts:1004 (run:resume:ok emitted after await enqueueRun)
impact: Caller believes a run resumed but no job exists - silent loss until manual retry
fix_sketch: Return 502/500 on enqueue failure (or include delivery flag); require resumeContext typed in EnqueueRunInput

title: jobId=channel:agent:message cannot represent a second attempt of the same run
evidence: queues.ts:119 (jobId); register-socket-server.ts:991-996 (resume messageId=resume:{runId}:{Date.now()} to dodge dedupe); queues.ts:33 (removeOnComplete 1h)
impact: A re-enqueued resume for the same run uses an ever-changing key (no dedupe at all) or is dropped as duplicate within the dedupe window; violates target standard (runId+attempt identity)
fix_sketch: Move to run:<runId>:attempt:<n>; keep channel:agent:message as secondary hint (doc Q1 awaiting operator)

title: Scheduler processor catches ANY job name starting with scheduled (prefix match)
impact: Future scheduled:* jobs silently routed to the trigger handler; mislabeled system messages possible
fix_sketch: Exact-match allowlist {scheduled:trigger, scheduled:cron} or route by data.kind

title: Duplicate resume enqueue returns fake success (id=jobId)
impact: Second resume click within retention window reports success but nothing new is queued (existing job may already be completed)
fix_sketch: Gate should return a status (created|duplicate|stale) so callers can distinguish; or unique key per attempt (see Q-3)

title: getFailedJobs returns runs-only; maintenance/scheduler DLQs invisible
fix_sketch: Extend getFailedJobs to accept queue selector or add listing ports (target standard)

title: Scheduler delayed add passes jobId without unique suffix - second identical delayed job returns existing (delayed) job
impact: Re-scheduling the same id before firing silently keeps the old delay/time
fix_sketch: Namespace jobId with timestamp or surface duplicate status

title: Snapshot-full reads runtimeOverrides with a shape guess: type mapping from overrideType runtime_patch->instruction, reason=createdBy, active hardcoded true
